note: Authored originals, seamless by construction. UVs must be world-scaled: u = world_metres / tile_metres.

dark_basalt_fortress.description: Dense dark basalt, tight joints, heavy blocks for the base of the wall.

rough_granite_block.description: Coarse speckled granite, deep pitting, wide blocks.

old_mortared_fieldstone.description: Irregular field stones swimming in broad mortar beds.

chipped_rubble_stone.description: Broken rubble coursing, edges knocked off, shallow bedding.

weathered_limestone_ashlar.description: Fine pale ashlar, close joints — the storey the arcade was designed in.

sandstone_block.description: Warm sandstone with visible bedding lines running with the course.

pale_limestone_light.description: The lightest ashlar, for the top storey where the wall meets the vault.

worn_courtyard_flagstone.description: Broad worn paving, dished centres, for floors rather than walls.
